{{Quote|I don't get it. It's just a dead animal, Chewie.|Han Solo|<ref name="ROTJ" />}}
A [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] '''tusked creature''' lived on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], a [[Tree/Legends|forested]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Endor (planet)/Legends|same name]]. This animal had a strong odor and was sometimes used as a bait by the native [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Bear/Legends|bear]]-like [[Hair/Legends|furry]] bipeds. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the heroes of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] fell into the net of an Ewok [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]], whose trap used one such creature as a bait.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Ewok_bait-BTM.jpg|thumb|left|The corpse of a tusked creature]]
{{Quote|Ticking up what? Try to be more specific, would you?|C-3PO, upon first hearing about Chewbacca's "olfactory delirium"|<ref name="ROTJN">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars'' Episode VI: ''Return of the Jedi'' novel]]</ref>}}
This mammal was a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] living on the lush [[Endor/Legends|Endor]],<ref name="ROTJ" /> one of the nine<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> natural [[Moon/Legends|satellites]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] also named [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="EAWGG">[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Empire at War'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> Its coarse and short [[Hair/Legends|fur]] was mostly [[Color/Legends|tan]], except for the white hair on the underbelly and around the [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] (the latter of which acted as a mane), and its flesh, when exposed, had a pinkish hue. The creature had a small mouth with four protruding tusks, two of which protruded upward. It also had a white mane on the ridge of the head, as well as small eyes with golden irises. It also had cloved hooves, as well as equestrian-like legs. The body of such animals released a stong odor that some meat-eating species found appealing.<ref name="BTM" /> The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], a race of furry giants from the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]],<ref name="ENC-W">{{SWE|groups|wookiees|Wookiees}}</ref> were very receptive to the smell of that Endorian tusked creature, which made their senses go wild, in some sort of "olfactory delirium."<ref name="ROTJN" />

==History==
[[File:Finding_the_dead_animal-ROTJ.png|thumb|250px|The heroes of the Rebel Alliance finding the caracass of a tusked creature]]
{{Quote|It would appear to be an animal carcass hang from a wooden pole.|C-3PO|<ref name="Radio">{{RJRadio|So Turns a Galaxy, So Turns a Wheel}}</ref>}}
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a [[Death/Legends|dead]] member of this tusked species was used as the bait of an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] trap, which consisted<ref name="ROTJ" /> of several<ref name="Return of the Jedi: The Storybook Based on the Movie">''[[Return of the Jedi: The Storybook Based on the Movie]]''</ref> shanks of raw<ref name="ROTJN" /> meat hanging from a wooden pole at the center of a glade. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] members [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], arrived on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] as part of a [[Battle of Endor/Legends|mission of inflitration]], were caught in.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Chewbacca had detected the animal's odor through the [[Tree/Legends|trees]], as its scent was very appealing to the hungry [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]], who was unable to resist and rushed to the stake.<ref name="BTM" /> Upon seeing it, [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] described it as "someone's lunch"<ref name="Radio" /> while Solo wondered if somebody hung it out to cure.<ref name="ROTJC" /> Unable to resist,<ref name="Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi junior novelization">[[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi (junior novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]]</ref> the moment Chewbacca tried to remove a piece of flesh from the carcass, a huge net sprang up all around the adventurers, instantly scooping them up high above the ground.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Endorian tusked creature was first seen in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], the third installment of the [[Original trilogy|original ''Star Wars'' trilogy]], which was released in [[1983]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> It was also featured in most adaptations of the movie, including the [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|novelization]],<ref name="ROTJN" /> the [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (1983)|comic series]]<ref name="ROTJC">[[Return of the Jedi 3|''Return of the Jedi'' 3]]</ref> and the [[Return of the Jedi (radio)|radio dramatization]].<ref name="Radio" />

This present article assumes the tusked creature is non-sentient, since both ''Return of the Jedi''<ref name="ROTJ" /> and the [[1998]] CD-ROM ''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'' explicitly call it an "animal."<ref name="BTM" /> Due to the full coat of hair covering its body, this species is likely [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]],<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> but no [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] source ever mentioned it.

While in the film the creature has a leg that ends with a hoof,<ref name="ROTJ" /> in the [[Star Wars Manga: Return of the Jedi 3|manga adapatation]] it ends with three [[Claw/Legends|claw]]-like fingers. In the manga Chewie manages to bite the carcass.<ref name="Star Wars Manga: Return of the Jedi 3">[[Star Wars Manga: Return of the Jedi 3|''Star Wars Manga: Return of the Jedi'' 3]]</ref>

In the current [[Canon]], the species has been identified as a "[[verkle]]".<ref name="Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!">''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]''</ref>
